description: A FastAPI router module defining an endpoint for querying a local PDF index using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Handles question input, invokes the RagPipeline service, and returns answers with supporting passages.

classes.name: QueryRequest
classes.description: Schema for incoming query requests containing the question and optional parameters.

classes.name: QueryResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response containing the answer and supporting passages.

classes.name: QueryAnswer
classes.description: Schema for the answer string and passages array.

classes.name: Passage
classes.description: Schema describing a passage with text, score, source, and chunk ID.

classes.name: ApiError
classes.description: Schema for error details in API responses.

classes.name: Meta
classes.description: Metadata about the API version and service.

methods.name: JSONResponse query_rag(payload: QueryRequest)
methods.description: Endpoint to process a question query via POST, invoke RAG pipeline, and return answer with passages.
